policies.name: Plastic Packaging Tax
policies.summary: Charges £200/tonne on plastic packaging containing less than 30% recycled content, pushing brands to use more recycled plastic.

policies.name: Ban on single-use plastic plates, cutlery, and polystyrene takeaway containers
policies.summary: Bans the supply of named single-use plastic items in England.

sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs

newsFeed.headline: UK deposit-return scheme delayed again to 2027
newsFeed.summary: Plans for a nationwide bottle-deposit scheme have slipped to 2027, drawing criticism from environmental groups.

wooby.headline: The UK taxes plastic packaging that doesn't have recycled stuff in it.
wooby.narrative: Wooby thinks the UK's idea is clever: if you make packaging from new plastic, you pay extra. If you use recycled plastic, you pay less. That makes recycling worth it for big brands.
